svg.text: Legacy audit: target TTP/RT50=300/28 ms, peak=1.000, integral=0.310 s; mapper=non-converged. The legacy LV plateau was not installed.

svg.text: Engineering center (not legacy-equivalent or a normal-human prior): TTP/RT50=116/126 ms, peak=0.831, integral=0.172 s.

svg.text: Dose policy: RT50 target 92/100/108%; effective onset, TTP, peak excursion, and activation integral stay fixed. Raw rise/decay/on/off coordinates remain private mapper details.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: P-qualified sustained-Q proxy changes 320→254 ms (Ao threshold cessation→MV threshold onset). Neither it nor cond-mid is anatomical leaflet timing or clinical IVRT.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: E/A progresses to partial-fusion, but diastasis remains 0 ms and there is no interior y in the tested local range. Partial fusion is not separation.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: LA pumping apex r_Pa changes 0.664→0.447; this is coupled evidence, not a morphology fit or a monotonic LV-relaxation claim.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Decision: within this uncalibrated local range, LV RT50 alone did not resolve the morphology. Do not tune AVPD or loading before independent LV calibration.

svg.text: Next: fixed-dose LA TTP and LA RT50 screens with this pressure-flow contract; defer PV Ar boundary claims and final acceptance to measured pulmonary/right-heart or full four-chamber integration.
